reject_approval_timeout: Shown when the host refuses a connection or pairing with the token "approval-timeout"; replaced by the host's own sentence when it sends one.
reject_bound_other: Shown when the host refuses a connection or pairing with the token "bound-other"; replaced by the host's own sentence when it sends one.
reject_busy: Shown when the host refuses a connection or pairing with the token "busy"; replaced by the host's own sentence when it sends one.
reject_denied: Shown when the host refuses a connection or pairing with the token "denied"; replaced by the host's own sentence when it sends one.
reject_host_power: Shown when the host refuses a connection or pairing with the token "host-power"; replaced by the host's own sentence when it sends one.
reject_identity_required: Shown when the host refuses a connection or pairing with the token "identity-required"; replaced by the host's own sentence when it sends one.
reject_launch_not_permitted: Shown when the host refuses a connection or pairing with the token "launch-not-permitted"; replaced by the host's own sentence when it sends one.
reject_no_seat: Shown when the host refuses a connection or pairing with the token "no-seat"; replaced by the host's own sentence when it sends one.
reject_not_armed: Shown when the host refuses a connection or pairing with the token "not-armed"; replaced by the host's own sentence when it sends one.
reject_profile_locked: Shown when the host refuses a connection or pairing with the token "profile-locked"; replaced by the host's own sentence when it sends one.
reject_profile_unknown: Shown when the host refuses a connection or pairing with the token "profile-unknown"; replaced by the host's own sentence when it sends one.
reject_rate_limited: Shown when the host refuses a connection or pairing with the token "rate-limited"; replaced by the host's own sentence when it sends one.
reject_seat_occupied: Shown when the host refuses a connection or pairing with the token "seat-occupied"; replaced by the host's own sentence when it sends one.
reject_seat_unavailable: Shown when the host refuses a connection or pairing with the token "seat-unavailable"; replaced by the host's own sentence when it sends one.
reject_setup_failed: Shown when the host refuses a connection or pairing with the token "setup-failed"; replaced by the host's own sentence when it sends one.
reject_superseded: Shown when the host refuses a connection or pairing with the token "superseded"; replaced by the host's own sentence when it sends one.
reject_wire_version: Shown when the host refuses a connection or pairing with the token "wire-version"; replaced by the host's own sentence when it sends one.
host_power_sleep: Host action: put the host computer to sleep.
host_power_reboot: Host action: restart the host computer.
host_power_shutdown: Host action: shut down the host computer.
host_power_restart_service: Host action: restart the Punktfunk service. Not the computer; the Windows tray and the web console show it.
host_power_confirm_title: Confirmation title before a host power action. {action} is the action's name, e.g. 'Restart host'.
apierr_account_network_denied: {account} is an account name. The policy name is Windows' own, shown as Windows shows it.
apierr_door_deck_stale: The command and "Konsole" (an app name) are literal: keep them.
apierr_door_missing_nix: The option is literal: keep it.
apierr_door_missing_package: Why the door can't turn on. {command} is a literal install command such as "sudo apt install punktfunk-seats".
apierr_door_missing_package_rpm_ostree: The command after the colon is literal: keep it.
apierr_door_missing_steamos: The command and "Konsole" (an app name) are literal: keep them.
apierr_door_missing_sysext: The command after the colon is literal: keep it.
apierr_door_not_in_update_group: Why the door can't turn on. {user} is the login name; the command is literal.
apierr_hooks_elevated_off: Refusal of an elevated hook. The command after the colon is literal: keep it exactly.
apierr_host_error: Generic refusal when the host's only text is an error chain; the app shows its own frame for the operation when it has one ('Couldn't delete this entry').
apierr_plugin_needs_newer_host: Store refusal. {version} is a version string such as 0.47.0.
apierr_plugin_needs_platform: Store refusal. {platforms} is a list of OS names joined by the app (e.g. "linux, windows").
apierr_profile_limit: Refusal to add a profile. {count} is PROFILES_MAX.
apierr_profile_lock_shared: Refusal to lock a profile that plays the owner's desktop. {owner} is the owner profile's name (data). "That profile" is the owner's.
apierr_title_in_use: Refusal to uninstall a game that is running. {title} is the game's title (data).
apierr_unlock_locked_out_device_minutes: Profile unlock lockout. {count} is seconds or minutes left, rounded up.
apierr_unlock_locked_out_device_seconds: Profile unlock lockout. {count} is seconds or minutes left, rounded up.
apierr_unlock_locked_out_password_minute: Profile unlock lockout. {count} is seconds or minutes left, rounded up.
apierr_unlock_locked_out_password_second: Profile unlock lockout. {count} is seconds or minutes left, rounded up.
apierr_update_apply_disabled: Refusal of a console update. The text in brackets is a setting name: keep it.
apierr_update_checks_disabled: Refusal of a forced check. The text in brackets is a setting name: keep it.
apierr_worker_action_check_stopped: 500 when the host's check of which actions it can run never finished.
apierr_worker_emulator_manager_stopped: 500 when the host's emulator manager never finished a request.
apierr_worker_install_stopped: 500 when a title's install on the host never finished starting.
apierr_worker_monitor_list_stopped: 500 when the host never finished reading its monitors.
apierr_worker_monitor_switch_stopped: 500 when switching the streamed monitor never finished.
apierr_worker_plugin_access_stopped: 500 when the host never finished reading or recording a plugin's access.
apierr_worker_plugin_store_stopped: 500 when the host's plugin store never finished a request.
apierr_worker_power_check_stopped: 500 when the host never finished checking whether it can sleep or shut down.
apierr_worker_profile_store_stopped: 500 when the host's profile store never finished a request.
apierr_worker_seat_stopped: 500 when a request to one profile's seat never finished.
apierr_worker_seat_check_stopped: 500 when the seats' checks never finished.
apierr_worker_seat_ledger_stopped: 500 when the host never finished reading its list of seats.
apierr_worker_seat_supervisor_stopped: 500 when a request to the seat service never finished.
apierr_worker_seats_stopped: 500 when a request about all seats never finished.
apierr_worker_switch_stopped: 500 when turning Reachable without logging in on or off never finished starting.
apierr_worker_windows_accounts_stopped: 500 when the host never finished reading this PC's Windows accounts.
close_lock_pin_wait_minutes: A locked profile's PIN lockout. {count} is minutes left, rounded up.
close_lock_pin_wait_seconds: A locked profile's PIN lockout. {count} is seconds left, rounded up.
close_monitor_missing: Why a session couldn't start. {monitor} is the connector name of the monitor the host is set to stream.
close_monitor_none: {monitor} is a connector name such as HDMI-A-1.
diag_door_no_device_summary: Why a device check does not apply on the door (the account-free login host).
diag_encoder_sharing_impact: {sessions} names the other encoder sessions (process names), joined with commas by the host.
diag_group_predates_summary: {group} is a Linux group name (punktfunk, input).
diag_niri_virtual_outputs_remedy: {url} is the docs link for getting biri.
diag_niri_virtual_outputs_silent_impact: {error} is niri's IPC error chain, English, shown as is.
diag_omarchy_updates_ok_summary: {version} is Omarchy's version, or the OS name when it has none. The command is literal.
diag_pad_audio_ok_summary: Health check, healthy. {count} is how many controller slots the endpoint serves.
diag_pad_driver_identity_summary: {got} and {want} are USB vendor:product ids such as 054C:0CE6.
diag_plugin_sandbox_bwrap_refused_impact: {error} is bubblewrap's own first stderr line, English, shown as is.
diag_plugin_sandbox_stopped_error_impact: {error} is the plugin runner's own refusal, English operator text, shown as is.
diag_restart_pending_summary: Health check: settings that wait for a restart. {settings} is a comma-separated list of setting names the console localizes from setting_<id>.
diag_server_conflict_summary: {servers} names the other servers (product names), joined with commas.
diag_takeover_privilege_impact: {dm} is the display manager's unit name, e.g. sddm.
diag_takeover_privilege_ok_summary: {user} is a login name, {group} a Linux group name.
diag_takeover_privilege_summary: {user} is a login name, {group} a Linux group name.
diag_uinput_access_denied_summary: {path} is a device path such as /dev/uinput.
diag_uinput_access_error_remedy: {path} is a device path such as /dev/uinput.
diag_uinput_access_error_summary: {path} is a device path; {error} is the OS error text, English, shown as is.
diag_uinput_access_missing_remedy: {path} is a device path such as /dev/uinput.
diag_uinput_access_missing_summary: {path} is a device path such as /dev/uinput.
diag_vdisplay_driver_not_ready_impact: {error} is the driver's own error text, English, shown as is.
diag_vdisplay_driver_not_ready_remedy: Remedy. "punktfunk Virtual Display" is the adapter name as Device Manager shows it: keep it.
diag_vdisplay_driver_wedged_remedy: Remedy. "punktfunk Virtual Display" is the adapter name as Device Manager shows it: keep it.
diag_virtual_deck_vhci_not_member_summar: {user} is a login name, {group} a Linux group name.
hostaction_display_next: Host action: stream the host's next physical monitor.
hostupdate_pacman_not_opted_in: Update result. {path} is the root-owned opt-in file, /etc/punktfunk/update.conf.
hostupdate_rolled_back: Update result. {from} and {to} are version strings.
launch_adopted: {title} is the game's title. Sent with kind Adopted, which clients do not show today.
launch_closed_at_once: {title} is the game's title. {seconds} is a number with one decimal, formatted by the app.
launch_download_failed_reason: {title} is the game's title. {reason} is the plugin's download error, its words, shown as is.
launch_download_refused: {title} is the game's title. {reason} is the plugin's own refusal, its words, shown as is.
launch_shared_screen: Toast when a device joins a screen another device opened (Play together) and the game it picked is not started.
seatcheck_account_administrator: Seat check about one seat. {account} is a Windows account name.
seatcheck_account_gone: Seat check about one seat. {account} is a Windows account name.
seatcheck_account_group: Seat check about one seat. {account} is a Windows account, {group} a local group name.
seatcheck_account_not_ours: Seat check about one seat. {account} is a Windows account name.
seatcheck_account_password_lost: Seat check about one seat. {account} is a Windows account name.
seatcheck_account_password_lost_adopted: Seat check about one seat. {account} is a Windows account name.
seatcheck_account_rights: Seat check about one seat. {account} is a Windows account name.
seatcheck_account_set_up: Seat check about one seat. {account} is a Windows account name.
seatcheck_account_set_up_adopted: Seat check about one seat. {account} is a Windows account name.
seatcheck_account_unreadable: Seat check about one seat. {account} is a Windows account name; {error} is Windows' own text, English.
seatcheck_architecture_unknown: Seat check. {error} is Windows' own error text, English, shown as is.
seatcheck_box_pin_changed: Seat check. {path} is the pin file.
seatcheck_child_state_running_session: Seat state in the seat doctor. {session} is a Windows session number.
seatcheck_device_list: Seat check. {error} is the read error, English, shown as is.
seatcheck_host_executable: Seat check. {path} is the missing file.
seatcheck_ledger: Seat doctor, first row. {count} is how many seats exist.
seatcheck_rds_grace_days: Seat check. {count} is days left (more than 30).
seatcheck_rds_grace_ending: Seat check, the last 30 days. {count} is days left.
seatcheck_seat_port_closed: Seat check about one seat. Both are port numbers.
seatcheck_seat_port_taken: Seat check about one seat. {port} is a port number.
seatcheck_seat_resources: Seat check about one seat. {slot} is a display slot number, the others port numbers.
seatcheck_steam_elsewhere: Seat check. {path} is Steam's folder; the second path is literal.
seatcheck_tools_missing: Seat check. {tools} lists program names (useradd, setfacl, …) joined with commas.
seatcheck_windows_build_ok: Seat check. {build} is the Windows build number.
seatcheck_windows_build_old: Seat check. {build} is the Windows build number.
seatcheck_windows_build_unknown: Seat check. {error} is Windows' own error text, English, shown as is.
seatline_sign_in_once: A take-turns profile that Windows has never signed in. {profile} is the profile's name.
seatline_stage_display_try: A starting seat on its retry. {attempt} and {total} are numbers.
seatline_stage_host_try: A starting seat on its retry. {attempt} and {total} are numbers.
seatline_stage_sign_in_try: A starting seat on its retry. {attempt} and {total} are numbers.
seatline_switching: A take-turns profile's seat while Windows switches accounts. {profile} is the profile's name.
